meta.description: Turn your idea into a business model with calculated numbers: a structured diagnostic, a report with a clear verdict, and an AI mentor.

home.heading: Turn your idea into a business model with calculated numbers
home.lead: The platform is under construction. It will give you a structured diagnostic of your business idea, a report with calculated numbers and a clear verdict, and an AI mentor that asks you the hard questions before the market does.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The link may have changed, or the page may have been removed.

eligibility.countryHint: We use it to pick the country data for your analysis. You can change it later.
eligibility.secondary: Have you finished secondary school (Tawjihi, Baccalauréat or equivalent)?
eligibility.terms: I accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and have read the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
eligibility.crossborder: I agree that the content of my projects, without my name or email, is sent to Anthropic in the United States to run the AI mentor. (Optional)
eligibility.crossborderHint: Without this consent the whole platform works except the AI mentor and other AI features. You can change your mind at any time on your account page.
eligibility.termsRequired: An account cannot be created without accepting the terms of use.
eligibility.refusedTitle: The platform is not available to you yet
eligibility.refusedSecondary: The platform is for people who have finished secondary school. You are welcome once you have.
eligibility.refusedAdult: The platform is for people aged 18 or older. You are welcome once you are.
eligibility.closedTitle: The platform is not available in your country yet
eligibility.closedBody: We will open sign-ups in your country soon.
eligibility.nothingStored: We have not kept any information about you.
eligibility.accountDeleted: We deleted the account created when you signed in and kept no information about you.

auth.signupLead: Three short steps: two declarations, your email, then the code we send you. No passwords.
auth.loginLead: We email you a 6-digit code. No passwords.
auth.emailHint: We use it only to send your sign-in code.
auth.codeSent: We sent a 6-digit code to <email>{address}</email>. It is valid for 10 minutes.
auth.codeSentLogin: If <email>{address}</email> has an account with us, a 6-digit code will arrive within a minute. It is valid for 10 minutes.
auth.changeEmail: Use another email or request a new code

errors.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email address, such as name@example.com.
errors.invalidCode: That code is wrong or has expired. Check the six digits or request a new code.
errors.rateLimited: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.failed: We could not complete that. Please try again shortly.
errors.signupExpired: Your sign-up timed out. Please answer the two declarations again.
errors.eligibility: Some answers are missing. Complete them to continue.
errors.google: Signing in with Google did not complete. Try again or use your email.

onboarding.title: Complete your account
onboarding.lead: Before you start we need two declarations. If this step is not completed within 24 hours, the account is deleted automatically.

projects.title: My projects
projects.soon: The diagnostic is being built and will appear here in the next milestone.

account.title: My account
account.languageHint: The language of the interface and of our emails.
account.crossborderTitle: AI mentor and processing outside your country
account.crossborderOn: Your consent is on: the content of your projects, without your name or email, is sent to Anthropic in the United States to run the AI mentor.
account.crossborderOff: Your consent is off: the AI mentor and other AI features are switched off, and the rest of the platform works fully.
account.deleteBody: Deletes your account and everything linked to it, at once and for good.
account.deleteConfirmBody: Your account and all your data will be deleted at once and cannot be recovered.

goodbye.title: Your account has been deleted
goodbye.body: We deleted your account and everything linked to it. You are welcome back at any time.
